scenario: Scenario B: Conflicting Picture in Grid Sector 7 (Primary Demo)
objectives: Identify and cross-reference divergent intelligence feeds under temporal delay
Resolve information asymmetry between Team Lead and Specialist roles before committing assets

decisions.prompt: Eagle-1 insists mechanized convoy is advancing. Specialist reports decoy Doppler and OP Echo warns of ambush. Issue order:
decisions.label: Preemptive Recon Flank to Ridge Charlie
decisions.feedback: Avoided the decoy, but acted on a single unverified HUMINT report and risked exposing the recon element.
